aw_ceiling_note: Additional Wage Ceiling = $102,000 - Total Ordinary Wages subject to CPF

next_change.summary: 加强年长员工退休储蓄，费率上调

cpf_critical_rules._note: 来自 CPF Board 官方FAQ的高频错误规则。必须严格区分。
cpf_critical_rules.wages_definition: CPF Act 下 Wages = 货币薪酬，包括奖金。来源: cpf.gov.sg/employer/employer-obligations/what-payments-attract-cpf-contributions
cpf_critical_rules.ow_definition: 须同时满足两个条件：①该月雇佣专属 ②次月14日前支付。来源同上
cpf_critical_rules.aw_formula: AW Ceiling = $102,000 - 年度CPF应缴OW总额（每个雇主每个日历年）

compensation_in_lieu_of_notice.rule: CPF NOT payable on compensation in lieu of notice。但员工最后工作日前工资仍需缴CPF。若雇主要求员工支付代通知金并决定从应发工资中抵扣，工资在抵扣前仍需缴CPF。

leave_encashment.rule: CPF IS payable on cash payment for encashment of leave。

non_wages: Genuine reimbursement for official purpose (不超过实际支出的官方费用报销)

allowance_reimbursement_classification._note: Payment名称不是CPF分类标准。必须根据payment nature判断。
judgment_chain: Payment → Wage or Genuine Official-Purpose Reimbursement?
If Reimbursement: CPF Wages = No (需满足official-purpose + 不超过实际支出条件)
If Wage: OW Conditions Satisfied? → Yes=OW, No=AW
ow_conditions: Wage is wholly or exclusively in respect of employment during that month
Wage for that month is payable by 14th of the following month
key_principles: Cash allowance 及其他增加工资的monetary payment → 可能属于wages并吸引CPF
Genuine reimbursement for official purpose → 报销金额不超实际支出时不属wages
Payment Label（如Transport Allowance/Meal Allowance/Communication Allowance/Housing Allowance）不直接确定OW或AW
企业要求津贴具有岗位业务理由 → 属于Internal Control或Compensation Policy，不是CPF Board判断OW/AW的法定标准
forbidden: Allowance → CPF Wages → OW（跳过Reimbursement判定和OW条件测试）
固定津贴属于OW（跳过两项OW条件）
因名称含Allowance直接确定OW/AW分类
以'是否有业务理由'替代CPF wage classification rule

final_salary_timing._note: 离职最终工资支付时限——primary deadline为last day，3 working days为fallback
final_salary_timing.resignation_without_notice: Within 7 days after last day of employment

employer_termination.fallback: Within 3 working days after termination date (if not possible on last day)

misconduct_dismissal.fallback: Within 3 working days after dismissal date (if not possible on last day)

forbidden: 雇主解雇员工后3个工作日内支付工资（省略last day primary）

sdl.applicability: 所有在新加坡工作的员工（含foreign employees），非'在册即缴'
sdl.not_applicable_to: Working overseas的员工，不因受雇于新加坡公司而自动缴纳
sdl.judgment_chain: Employee → Working in Singapore? → Yes: apply SDL rules; No: do not automatically impose SDL
forbidden: 所有公司员工包括外籍都缴SDL
以'在employee register'替代'working in Singapore'判断
